card.title: Nintendo Switch Joycons not charging or connecting Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Joycons not charging or connecting Repair

symptoms: Joy-Cons not charging or pairing on rails

claims.statement: If the two Joy-Con DC-DC resistors read 18 kΩ each instead of 100 kΩ and 22 kΩ, a capacitor has failed even if it doesn't test shorted; pin 6 of the DC-DC should read 0 in diode mode (0.6 drop confirms).
If the resistors check out, the DC-DC converter may need replacing.

procedure: Measure both resistors (100 kΩ / 22 kΩ expected).
Replace the failed cap or DC-DC converter.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
